benchmark_run: BankerToolBench official Harbor tasks + native rubric verifier (6-task seeded subset)
metric: mean native verifier reward (rubric raw_score/max_score, 0-1) per task; errors/no-deliverable = 0
grader: native (BTB gandalf rubric verifier, judge gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview per task grader.toml)
compute_route: Tinker sampling via local OpenAI-compatible shim (E4/code/tinker_shim.py); Harbor 0.20 + opencode agent in local Docker (colima aarch64)
commands: SHIM_KEY=... E4/code/shim_loop.sh E4 18741   # base-model shim; cap file raw/cap.json
E4/code/e4_loop.sh btb-11e08646 btb-07727295 btb-bc55d3e8 btb-507a3d72 btb-990cf5d7   # per-task cap 500k tokens
python E4/code/compute_result.py btb-19b3361c btb-11e08646 btb-07727295 btb-bc55d3e8 btb-507a3d72 btb-990cf5d7

prior_base_run.caveat: Served through the Modal bridge /v1/responses path, which passed no stop tokens (stop=None, decode skip_special_tokens) and whose responses->chat converter drops string message content and prior function_call items. Trajectories show generation running past <|im_end|> into fake 'user/<tool_response>/assistant' turns. The 0.0 most likely measures those bridge defects, not the base model; not comparable to this run.

caveats: Small n=6 of 100; wide interval. Wilson95 computed on summed fractional reward (approximation for a [0,1] score).

Per-task Tinker budget 500k tokens (task 1 ran under a 700k cap but used 115k). btb-11e08646 and btb-07727295 hit the cap (HTTP 402 -> opencode exit 1) and scored 0; the budget, not only the model, bounds these.
btb-bc55d3e8 ended in a Harbor CancelledError (external process cancellation, no verifier run); counted as error = 0.
btb-507a3d72, btb-990cf5d7: agent stopped without writing deliverables -> native verifier returns 0.

Shim forces enable_thinking=False and temperature=0 although opencode passes --thinking; context 65,536 with opencode compaction at 49,152; 8192-token default output so some long file-writing tool calls truncated (finish=length).
Two earlier attempts of btb-19b3361c and one of btb-07727295/btb-bc55d3e8 died on Docker daemon loss / host disk-full (raw/infra_failed_attempts/); rerun from scratch, not model outcomes.
New arm (base weights); never pool with the original 0.3115 recovery metric or seed809 scores.
